facts.fact: PayLogic announced on 25 August 2025 that the Comoros National Payment Switch is in service, providing interoperability between banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money operators.
PayLogic says the national payment switch, now operational, handles real-time transfers, merchant payments and diaspora remittances across banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money operators.

COM.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
